extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, students, and general readers interested in journalism awards
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the criteria and category structure used by the George Polk Awards (Long Island University) to recognize excellence in journalism across media, including the premium placed on investigative, original, resourceful, and thought-provoking work. Also captures the award's categories and the Career Award for lifetime achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award purpose (Awarded for)
rubrics_metrics.description: To honor excellence in print and broadcast journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The George Polk Awards are presented annually by Long Island University to recognize outstanding work in journalism; the page's lead states the award is "Awarded for: To honor excellence in print and broadcast journalism."

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on reporters' work (intrepid, bold, influential)
rubrics_metrics.description: The award "focuses on the intrepid, bold, and influential work of the reporters themselves."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis is placed on the qualities of the reporting and the reporter — bravery (intrepid), boldness, and influence — rather than institutional prestige alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium on investigative work
rubrics_metrics.description: Places a premium on investigative work that is "original, resourceful, and thought-provoking."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigative reporting that demonstrates originality, resourcefulness, and provokes thought is especially valued by the Polk Awards (verbatim language from the LIU description).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition across all media
rubrics_metrics.description: Described as "the first major award of its kind to recognize reporting across all media."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award's scope is cross-media: historically focused on print and broadcast but explicitly inclusive of other media formats (e.g., internet/blogs, documentary film).

rubrics_metrics.name: George Polk Career Award (lifetime achievement)
rubrics_metrics.description: The George Polk Career Award is given in recognition of an individual's lifelong achievements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate from the yearly reporting categories, this award honors an individual's entire career contributions to journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes excellence in reporting on international affairs; one of the named Polk Award categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radio reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes excellence in journalism produced for radio/audio formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photojournalism (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes excellence in photographic reporting and visual storytelling in journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting that illuminates economic issues, trends, and analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes coverage of business topics, corporate affairs, and financial journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes journalism focused on labor, workplace, unions, and related issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting on legal matters, courts, and justice system issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: National reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting on national/domestic issues of broad significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes journalism published online; the page notes that in 2008 Talking Points Memo was the first blog to receive a Polk Award, illustrating the category's inclusion of digital-native work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magazine reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes feature and investigative reporting published in magazines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting on military affairs, defense, and war correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: State reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting on state-level government, politics, and public policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting that covers education systems, policy, and related issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes journalism focused on local communities, municipal government, and regional issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Television reporting (category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes excellence in television broadcast journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary film (category; introduced 2014)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes long-form documentary filmmaking as a form of journalistic reporting; this category was added in 2014, expanding the award's media coverage.
